title: Senior Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.
 Our data flows from our applications, product events and business systems, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to build the platform that makes sure that data arrives complete, on time and safe to use, so Product, leadership, RevOps and Finance work from the same numbers.
 You will be the first data engineer in a new data team that sits in Product, works across the company and reports to the Head of Data. You will own the platform that moves our data into Snowflake and shape the architecture decisions around it: which tools we build on, how pipelines are orchestrated and monitored, and how data infrastructure is managed as code.
 What to expect This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Data Engineer:
 Purposeful work – your work gives the teams serving hospitals and aftercare providers data they can trust.
 Real ownership – as the first data engineer in a new team, you shape the data platform and its tooling.
 Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.
 Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare…

title: Data Engineer (Detect & Track Distillation)
description:
About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 ABOUT THE ROLE
 Our ML teams train models on datasets derived from large volumes of raw, unstructured data. Model quality depends directly on data quality, and today that data is handled largely by hand.
 As a Data Engineer, operating out of Paris, Lausanne, or Zurich, you will own the data layer that feeds the team's models, from raw field logs or public datasets through curated, versioned, training-ready datasets. You will manage terabytes of raw, unstructured data and turn it into clean, documented, versioned datasets, so that the modelers spend their time designing and training models, not waiting on data loaders or wrangling corrupted files. You join at an early stage with real influence over how field and public data gets processed for deep-learning pipelines.
 RESPONSIBILITIES
 Ingestion Pipeline: Ingest, decode, and store raw, unstructured field data (video and other sensor streams) from field logs into efficient, controlled formats.
 Multimodal Alignment: Align multiple data streams temporally and spatially so paired data is usable for training.
 Curation: Transfer both ingested data and public datasets into high-value data, including parsing, filtering, de-duplication and revision.
 Data & Labeling Requirements: Define which data to gather and what and how to label it, and own the dataset-construction workflow and labeling tooling. Coordinate with the teams responsible for data gathering and lab…

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Data Platform Engineer to own the data foundation our AI agents run on.
 Procurement data is messy: ERP transactions, contracts, spreadsheets, PDFs and email, spread across systems that were never designed to talk to each other. You'll build the ingestion pipelines and schemas that turn that into something autonomous agents can reason over, and set the quality and lineage standards that make it trustworthy enough for a Fortune 500 to act on.
 We’ve built the early foundations but there’s still plenty to build - you’ll shape the architecture to serve hundreds of enterprise customers.
 We're building next-generation agentic systems that can manage entire procurement workflows, with a mission to make global manufacturing supply chains more resilient to an ever-changing world. That's a $3tn market opportunity.
 We're backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, and you'll be joining a team bringing together experience from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey.
 What You’ll Do Design, implement and operate ingestion pipelines processing high-volume data from global supply chain and procurement systems.
 Define, evolve, and manage data schemas and catalogues—from raw staging to high-quality analytics and feature stores.
 Build end-to-end monitoring and observability for your pipelines: owning data quality, latency, completeness, and lineage at every stage.
 Champion secure, governed data practices
 Collaborate closely with AI, Platform, and Product teams, provisioning data sets, feature tables, and contracts for analytics and machine learning at scale.

 Have experience developing data warehouses/lakehouses

title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
description:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.
 About the Role
 You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.
 We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.
 The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.
 It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.
 What you'll be doing
 Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
 Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them

title: Data Engineer
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY; Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Anthropic's go-to-market teams are scaling quickly, and the decisions they make, from who to sell to and how to cover them to where to invest next, are only as good as the intelligence and infrastructure underneath them. As a Data Engineer on the GTM Systems data foundations team, you'll help build that layer: the data products that give sellers, operators, and analysts a rich, current, and trusted picture of the market, and the engineering rigor that lets our GTM systems run reliably as the business grows.
 This is an engineering role that goes beyond pipelines. You'll treat GTM data as a product and a platform: built once, kept current, and available wherever people work. Alongside the build, you'll help shape what the data means: how attributes are defined, which sources are trusted, and how the business puts them to use. The role sits at the intersection of the sales organization, the data organization, and the systems that data flows through. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy and Operations, Finance, Data Science, and the central data engineering team.

 Bring disparate internal and external sources together: orchestrate, model, and normalize first-party product and revenue data alongside third-party data into one usable understanding of the company landscape
 Build and maintain identity and entity resolution, so every source attaches to one trusted record for each company and the relationships between companies are clear
